versioning_rules: protocol_version must change on any methodological amendment
frozen preregistration identifiers must remain immutable after freeze
amendment_rules: post-freeze amendments require new amendment record and explicit rationale
post-freeze amendments cannot silently replace thresholds or endpoint families
freezing_rules: freeze must occur before reviewer selection finalization
freeze must occur before human data collection
freeze must bind threshold declarations and negative control families
invalid_retrospective_edits: post-hoc threshold change without amendment record
blinding_unblinding_rules: reviewers remain blinded to condition labels until preregistered unblinding condition is met
unblinding must be logged with cause, timestamp, and authority class
threshold_declaration_rules: threshold family must be declared before freeze
no threshold may be selected from observed data
analysis_family_declaration_rules: analysis family must map to a declared statistical shell
analysis family changes after freeze require amendment record
negative_control_declaration_rules: negative control families must be enumerated before freeze
omitted negative controls must carry explicit rationale
interpretation_boundary: This is a local preregistration template. It is not an externally filed preregistration record.
